class.name: EditorExportPlatformN64
class.brief_description: Exporter for Nintendo 64. Writes a .z64 by spawning blazium-toolchain. No Godot export templates.
class.description: [EditorExportPlatformN64] appears in Project → Export as "N64" on Windows and Linux hosts only. Export runs [code]blazium-toolchain n64 setup --profile compile[/code] (if needed) then [code]n64 build --out[/code] using the guest stub bundled in the toolchain. The product is a big-endian [code].z64[/code] ([code]80 37 12 40[/code]). There is no ISO, CUE, Godot template, or [code].tpz[/code]. Guest [code]*.cpp[/code] is written next to the ROM under [code]guest/[/code]. Optional Editor Setting [code]export/n64/runtime_src[/code] replaces the stub ([code]--src[/code]). [code]export/n64/runtime_overlay[/code], [code]BLAZIUM_N64_OVERLAY[/code], or project [code]res://n64_guest[/code] overlays extra or replacement sources ([code]--overlay[/code]). Preset [code]n64/region[/code] is NTSC, PAL, or region-free; v1 framebuffer is 320×240. One-click runs [code]blazium-toolchain n64 run[/code] (Windows default Project64, Linux Ares; skip a missing validator). No PIF or BIOS dump is required. GDExtension and C# are rejected. This class does not call [code]find_export_template()[/code] or [code]save_pack()[/code] and never searches [code]C:\ultra[/code].
